full_judgment: 2. Facts leading to the issuance of this Rule are that the Petitioner as Plaintiff instituted the Title Suit No.227 of 1962 in the Court of the Munsif, Sunamgonj on 14.12.1962 against the predecessors of the present Opposite Parties praying for .a decree for declaration of title in the suit land and for recovery for its khas possession. The suit was decreed on 30.5.1963 ex parte.
